fusions.name: Crystal Shard
fusions.desc: Fires a crystal shard of raw force that deals 7 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Geode Burst
fusions.desc: Looses a resonant burst 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 14 arcane damage to everything in it and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ley Draw
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of crystal that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Charged Core
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
